# Math Experiments

By Hari Naralasetty, working with AI agents.

The work added 1,350 new terms to 10 OEIS sequences, made partial progress on BB(6), and found no new records in the three record-search batches. Every new term is checked by two independent programs. The terms have not yet been submitted to the OEIS. BB(6) remains undecided; no record improvement is claimed.

- AI Agents Find 1,350 New Terms for Open Math Sequences: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/
- New terms for OEIS A391646: least integers with a specified sum of prime-factor remainders: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A391646.html
- New terms for OEIS A383533: partitions without ones admitting disjoint strict refinements: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A383533.html
- New terms for OEIS A374679: compositions with strictly increasing anti-run leaders: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A374679.html
- New terms for OEIS A353390: compositions containing their own run lengths as a subsequence: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A353390.html
- New terms for OEIS A335457: patterns found in consecutive parts of compositions: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A335457.html
- New terms for OEIS A374680: compositions with strictly decreasing anti-run leaders: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A374680.html
- New terms for OEIS A374681: compositions with weakly increasing anti-run leaders: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A374681.html
- New terms for OEIS A374682: compositions with weakly decreasing anti-run leaders: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A374682.html
- New terms for OEIS A383710: partitions admitting no disjoint strict refinements: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A383710.html
- New terms for OEIS A383711: partitions without ones admitting no disjoint strict refinements: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/A383711.html
- OEIS sequences extended: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/oeis/index.html
- Busy Beaver BB(6): partial progress: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/bb6.html
- Record searches: no new records: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/horizonmath.html
- How to check the results yourself: https://harinaralasetty.github.io/math-experiments/reproduce.html
